note.en: Dynamic Stacking, will be done alongside of stacking **[[set:nymphs-dream]] (4)**.
note.fr: Stacking dynamique en parallèle du stacking de **[[set:nymphs-dream]] (4)**.
note.ru: Урон зависит от количества полученных уровней. Ротация для получения уровней соответствует таковой для Сна нимфы (4).

note.en: Makes [[stat:em]] highly valuable, especially in rotations like **{rot:N2C} or {rot:N1C}**.
note.fr: Rends la [[stat:em]] très précieuse, surtout dans les rotations comme **{rot:N2C} ou {rot:N1C}**.
note.it: Quest'arma rende la [[stat:em]] molto desiderabile, specialmente in rotazioni che utilizzano {rot:N2C} o {rot:N1C}.
note.ru: Повышает ценность Мастерства стихий, особенно при использовании комбо {rot:N2C} или {rot:N1C}.

note.en: In teams with 1 other [[element:hydro]] character, this weapon performs better than **[[weapon:the-daybreak-chronicles]]**.

**At [R5]]** with another [[element:hydro]] character on the team, this weapon performs better than **[[weapon:aqua-simulacra]]**.
**At [R5]** with no other [[element:hydro]] character on the team, this weapon performs better than **[[weapon:skyward-harp]]**.

Offers a valuable passive that helps a lot in **grouping enemies**, which can offer a ton of damage from Riptide.
[[note:r5-better]] **[[weapon:golden-frostbound-oath]]**.
note.fr:
Offre un passif précieux qui aide beaucoup à **regrouper les ennemis**, ce qui peut offrir énormément de dégâts de Contre-courant.
[[note:r5-better]] **[[weapon:golden-frostbound-oath]]**.
note.it:
La passiva di quest'arma è molto efficace nel raggruppare i nemici, il che può aiutare a massimizzare i danni da Risacca (Riptide).
[[note:r5-better]] **[[weapon:golden-frostbound-oath]]**.
note.ru:
Имеет ценную Пассивную способность, помогающую стягивать противников, позволяя наносить высокий урон при помощи Отлива.
[[note:r5-better]] **[[weapon:golden-frostbound-oath]]**.

note.en: Have to change double [[element:swirl]] setup to use a [[ability:ca]] instead of a [[ability:skill]].
note.fr: Nécéssite de changer le setup de Double [[element:swirl]] en utilisant une [[ability:ca]] au lieu d'un [[ability:skill]].
note.it: È necessario cambiare la rotazione per attivare un doppio [[element:swirl]], usando un [[ability:ca]] al posto dell'[[ability:skill]].
note.ru: Для подготовки двойного рассеивания в ротации следует использовать Заряженную атаку вместо Элементального навыка.

note.en:
This ranking assumes you are playing 2 Natlan or non-[[element:hydro]] characters on the team.
With 3 Natlan or non-[[element:hydro]] characters, this weapon performs better than **[[weapon:scion-of-the-blazing-sun]]**.
